name: Daily owner report from Xero (The Gantry blueprint)

parameters.content:
## Daily owner report from Xero
Blueprint by The Gantry (gantry.work).

1. Fill in **Settings**: who gets the report (comma-separate several), and your Xero organisation name if you have more than one.
2. Create one Xero credential and select it on all four Xero steps (the payments step uses the same credential through the HTTP Request node).
3. Connect Gmail on **Email the report**.
4. Optional: enable **Telegram line** and put your chat ID in Settings.
5. Test once, then activate. It runs 8am Singapore time, Monday to Friday. Monday's report covers Friday to Sunday.

To re-send a past day, put that date (YYYY-MM-DD) in reportDate and click Test workflow. Clear it afterwards.
